rights_basis: Faithful bounded reading transcription of original-language liturgical text from Paris 1481 (Missale Parisiense): complete strict Canon Missae constituent, whose United States copyright term has expired by publication date (22 September 1481 Paris publication (Dupré and Huym colophon)). Derived directly from tracked public-domain facsimile artifact.diocese-of-paris.missale-parisiense.1481-paris-dupre-huym.ia-complete-pdf-619ed4e7 without modern translation or editorial reconstruction. text: Supra que propicio. ac sereno vultu respicere digneris. et accepta habere sicuti accepta habere dignatus es munera pueri tui iusti abel. et sacrificium patriarche nostri abrahe. et quod tibi obtulit summus sacerdos tuus melchisedech sanctum sacrificium. imaculatam hostiam
